from sympy import Matrix, symbols, simplify, S

# Reported setup
a, b, k = symbols('a b k', real=True)
A = Matrix([[a, k*a], [b, k*b]])
Q, R = A.QRdecomposition()

expr_reconstruct = simplify(Q) * simplify(R)
QQ = (Q.H * Q).applyfunc(simplify)

def has_nan(expr):
    return expr.has(S.NaN)

probe('reconstruction_simplified_Q_times_R', expr_reconstruct)
probe('reconstruction_has_nan', has_nan(expr_reconstruct))
probe('QQ_has_S_NaN', has_nan(QQ))
probe('A_rank', A.rank())
probe('Q_cols', Q.cols)
probe('rank_cols_match', A.rank() == Q.cols)
probe('QQ_matrix', QQ)
probe('reconstruction_minus_A_simplified', simplify(expr_reconstruct - A))
probe('expected_zeros_equal_reconstruction_minus_A', simplify(expr_reconstruct - A) == Matrix.zeros(2,2))
